text:
alex.w: Heads up — noticed fallback chain ignoring X-Route-Tenant header when the route matcher runs during capacity-shed. Request with tenant header 'alpha' routed to generic backup 'small-v2' instead of tenant-specific 'alpha-small'.

maria.k: can you paste the raw headers + route rules so we can see the exact behavior?

alex.w: example below (sanitized):
```
Headers:
X-Route-Tenant: alpha
X-Quota-Class: low

Route rules:
- match: tenant == alpha -> primary: alpha-large, backup: alpha-small
- match: region == eu -> primary: eu-large, backup: small-v2
Shed mode: global capacity-shed = true
```

samir: are we normalizing/stripping headers earlier than routing? iirc the gateway strips "non-essential" headers during the shed pass to cut cardinality.

devops-bot: probe result: 200 OK -> routed to small-v2; trace shows X-Route-Tenant present in request but not present in route-matcher trace.

riya: i can repro locally with shed=true. seems the fallback selector collapses affinity dimension when capacity flags are set — it drops tenant key and only considers region/size.

maria.k: ok that explains the mismatch. was that an intentional simplification to share backups across tenants under extreme load?

ben.p: not intentional for sticky tenant routing. there was an optimization (2023q4) to collapse tenant-affinity for backups to reduce routing cardinality under massive spikes. it should have been behind a flag but landed as default.

alex.w: proposal: make the fallback_affinity explicit in route config, e.g. `fallback_affinity: ["tenant", "region"]` with precedence. add a per-route console toggle "preserve-header-affinity" so tenants can opt into tenant-specific backups even during shed.

console-bot: RFC created: RFC-1042 "Configurable fallback affinity + console toggle".

riya: telemetry gap: our traces only show final target, not which affinity keys were considered. we should emit `fallback_decision` log with fields: considered:["tenant","region"], chosen:"small-v2", reason:"capacity-shed".

samir: +1. also add metric `fallback_misroute` with tag header_present_but_ignored=1 so we can alert on regressions.

maria.k: i'll draft the design doc and schema diff. any objections to making the new flag default-off and then canary enabling for beta orgs?

ben.p: i'll own the canary rollout and wire a circuit-breaker threshold — if p90 latency or error rate spikes after enabling preserve-header-affinity, we roll back.

alex.w: thanks all. next steps: maria -> PR for route config/schema change; riya -> telemetry + log format; ben -> canary plan + CB thresholds; i'll open follow-up thread for unit/integration testcases and a quick perf test harness.

maria.k: noted — will post PR link and a migration checklist.

(quick emoji reactions in thread: :thumbsup: :eyes: :warning:)
